algolia.name: Amped Wireless - High Power Wireless-N 600mW Smart Repeater and Range Extender
algolia.description: Extend the range of any Wi-Fi network by repeating the wireless signal and redistributing it in a new location. Includes 5 wired ports. Uses dual, high power 600mW amplifiers and high gain antennas to provide up to 10,000 sq ft of extended coverage.
